correctness.rationale: For odd n the mod-two cyclic shift diagonalizes in a separable splitting field; a primitive n-th root and a two-element Jordan block give exact mod-two order 2n. Exact U_m(b) Laurent sums, Taylor expansion at b+2, the characteristic-two doubling derivative and the odd-n idempotent Sigma yield T^(2n)=I+2 Sigma I mod4. This is nonidentity; squaring gives identity mod8. The uniform-mode evaluation H^4-I=8[[5,14],[7,19]] is nonzero mod16 for odd n. Standard exact 2-adic lifting then determines every modulus. An actual standalone verifier checks odd n from 3 to 25 and powers 1 to 10, 416 exact checks; finite tests are not used as infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The new all-odd-n order theorem applies to the unequal-shear matrix [[I,B],[I,I+B]], B=S+S^-1. The nearest 2026 circulant and published complete-graph period results instead use [[I,C],[C,I+C^2]]; their characteristic traces 2+C^2 differ from 2+B and neither supplies a conjugacy, reduction, or covering theorem for arbitrary odd-cycle unequal shears. The 2011 high-dimensional extension is another construction and does not assert this order law. Full relevant texts of the 2026 paper and 2011 paper, together with the published complete-graph finding, were inspected; historical unindexed equivalences remain possible.

value.rationale: An exact all-odd-size, all-dyadic-resolution restoration-time law for a natural graph-coupled, area-preserving shear map resolves a motivated modular dynamics invariant. The stationary order between mod4 and mod8 is a nontrivial arithmetic resonance, proved by a projector identity; a sharp single-mode obstruction then drives uniform subsequent doubling. Unlike a routine fixed-size computation this gives an entire infinite class and a mechanism plausibly useful for other mixed-shear systems.
